original_text: <!-- (audio) James: Compliance is when we put specific rules, policies, and regulations that are important to our industry into practice. It helps promote ethics at the workplace. -->
translated_text: <!-- (audio) James: Komplijansa je kada primenjujemo specifična pravila, politike i propise koji su važni za našu industriju. To pomaže u podizanju etike na radnom mestu. -->
